content.value_statement: Influencer submissions can miss campaign, claim, disclosure, and platform requirements. This skill applies the C3 ART gate and produces evidence-linked revision feedback.
actual_capabilities: Reviews one influencer asset or a tightly defined asset set against a frozen campaign brief.
Evaluates all 12 C3 ART items across Appeal, Relevance, and Transparency.
Flags missing disclosures and false or unsubstantiated claims as veto-level issues.
Checks brand alignment, approved messages, platform requirements, and technical evidence.
Produces location-specific revision feedback with required corrections and resubmission conditions.
Can validate and persist a typed audit artifact after explicit user approval.
limitations: Requires the exact submission, brief version, approved claims, market, platform, and campaign goal.
Does not draft campaign briefs, adjudicate legal rights, approve claims, or calculate campaign return.
Cannot produce a scored gate when the verified deterministic runtime is unavailable.
Provides compliance review support, not legal advice or a substitute for qualified counsel.

use_cases.title: Gate Sponsored Content
use_cases.description: Review a creator submission before publication, amplification, or a payment milestone.

use_cases.title: Check Disclosure and Claims
use_cases.description: Identify missing sponsorship disclosure and unsupported product claims before compliance approval.

use_cases.title: Verify Creator Revisions
use_cases.description: Compare a revised asset with prior feedback and confirm whether each required change is complete.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Content Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this influencer post against the attached brief. Identify approval blockers and provide a concise revision note.
prompt_templates.scenario: First review of a single creator submission

prompt_templates.title: Compliance Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Check this sponsored [platform] asset for disclosure, approved claims, brand alignment, and technical requirements. Mark missing evidence as unknown.

prompt_templates.title: Full ART Gate
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the C3 ART review for this [goal] campaign. Score all 12 items and cite evidence for every decision.

prompt_templates.title: Versioned Re-Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Re-review version [number] against brief [version] and claims [version]. Compare prior issues, verify fixes, preserve typed status, and draft creator feedback.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of a revised submission

output_examples.input: Review a sponsored video with no visible disclosure.
output: Decision: Reject and hold this version.
Blocker: Required sponsorship disclosure is absent.
Correction: Add clear disclosure in the asset and caption, then resubmit.

output_examples.input: Review a caption that includes an unsupported performance claim.
output: Issue: The performance claim has no approved substantiation.
Next step: Provide current evidence or remove the claim before scoring.

output_examples.input: Re-review an asset after all requested changes.
output: Verified: Disclosure, approved messaging, and technical requirements now pass.
Result: The revised version can proceed to publication.

best_practices: Provide frozen versions of the asset, brief, claims record, market rules, and platform requirements.
Require dated evidence for every ART state and keep missing evidence marked as unknown.
Request exact locations, owners, corrections, and resubmission conditions for every required change.
anti_patterns: Do not approve content when required disclosure or claim evidence is missing.
Do not let strong creative quality offset a disclosure or claim-integrity failure.
Do not use this skill to draft briefs, decide contract rights, or calculate campaign return.

faq.question: What content can this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews one influencer deliverable or a tightly defined asset set with its caption and supporting campaign evidence.

faq.question: Does it check sponsorship disclosure?
faq.answer: Yes. It evaluates disclosure when a material connection exists and treats verified absence or inadequacy as a veto.

faq.question: Can it verify product claims?
faq.answer: It compares claims with approved substantiation. It does not independently approve new claims or provide legal advice.

faq.question: What happens when evidence is missing?
faq.answer: Applicable items remain unknown, and the skill returns a needs-evidence result instead of guessing a score.

faq.question: Can it save the audit result?
faq.answer: Yes, but only after explicit approval and successful validation with the verified repository runtime.

faq.question: Does it replace other campaign skills?
faq.answer: No. Brief creation, creator scoring, contract terms, claim approval, and campaign return require their dedicated workflows.
